formant_baselines.praat_default: Praat Burg, defaults (5 formants, 5500 Hz ceiling)
formant_baselines.praat_sweep: Praat Burg, 4000-8000 Hz ceiling sweep, FastTrack-style DCT selection (oracle vowel span)
formant_baselines.praat_fasttrack: Praat Burg, FastTrack's per-talker-group ceiling ranges (men 4500-6500, women 5000-7000, children 5500-7500 Hz) and selection error (speaker group + oracle vowel span)
formant_baselines.qcp_fb_published: QCP-FB as published (Gowda et al. 2017): duration quotient 0.7, 8 kHz, SEDREAMS GCIs (D-046 arm A; not adopted)
formant_baselines.qcp_fb: QCP-FB, duration quotient 0.3, 10 kHz, SEDREAMS GCIs (D-046 arm B; narrowly failed its gate, not adopted; report-only)
formant_baselines.fasttrack_qcp_snap: FastTrack (as praat_fasttrack), each formant snapped to the nearest QCP-FB (arm B) peak within 15 %
formant_baselines.fasttrack_smooth_qcp_snap: FastTrack smoothed (median 5 frames, then a zero-phase leaky integrator, alpha 0.15, log Hz), snapped as fasttrack_qcp_snap
formant_baselines.fasttrack_dct_qcp_snap: FastTrack's own DCT fit (intercept + 5 cosines) as the seed, snapped as fasttrack_qcp_snap
formant_baselines.teacher: teacher teacher_v1 step 20000 (sha d6a6a64beb52-fp32-w400), trained on synthetic data only

pesto.description: PESTO mir-1k_g7 (pesto-pitch 2.0.1), 10 ms hop; voiced if confidence >= 0.5

crepe.description: CREPE full (torchcrepe 0.0.24), Viterbi decoding, 50-1600 Hz, 10 ms hop; voiced if periodicity >= 0.21

praat_ac.description: Praat autocorrelation (parselmouth), defaults except range 50-1000 Hz, 10 ms grid; unvoiced frames have no estimate

teacher.description: teacher teacher_v1 step 20000 (sha d6a6a64beb52-fp32-w400), trained on synthetic data only; voiced if voicing p >= 0.5
